summary: Master Smith Burninate seeks the fiery flux plans in the Slag Pit. Maltorius left their clan with the recipe, which Burninate values above a pristine arcane crystal, and believes the plans are near him.

sections.title: The Stolen Recipe
sections.body: Master Smith Burninate says Maltorius betrayed their clan when he left with the fiery flux recipe. Burninate suspects that recipe helped Maltorius earn his new promotion among the Dark Irons. Now Burninate wants the secret plans returned.

sections.title: Into the Slag Pit
sections.body: Master Smith Burninate believes the plans lie near Maltorius, deep in the Slag Pit. He wants you to carry the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux back to him.

faq.q: Who stole the recipe for fiery flux?
faq.answer: Maltorius stole the fiery flux recipe, according to Master Smith Burninate. Burninate calls him a traitor to their clan.

aliases: where to find fiery flux plans
faq.answer: Burninate believes the secret plans lie close to Maltorius, deep in the Cauldron's Slag Pit.

faq.q: Who asks for the plans to be recovered?
faq.answer: Master Smith Burninate, a smith, wants the plans returned.

faq.q: Why do the plans matter to Burninate?
faq.answer: Burninate says the clan's secret fiery flux recipe is worth more than a pristine arcane crystal.
